gh issue comment 3076 --repo paiml/aprender --body Plan (0.67.0 orchestrator, supersedes the one-line triage note above): **0.68.0** (train leaves 2026-09-15T06:00Z). Two deliverables in one PR: (1) the GGUF CPU path gets a SIMD f16/bf16 matvec (dequant-to-f32 tiles through the existing fused dispatcher) with a greedy-parity gate against llama.cpp on an unquantized ≤1B GGUF, so an F16/BF16 model decodes at a measured tok/s instead of appearing to hang; (2) until that lands the loader prints a one-line notice that the F16/BF16 path is scalar and slow rather than silently crawling. Not in 0.67.0 because its cut is 2026-09-12T18:00Z with the queue already full; you'll get the measured before/after tok/s on this ticket.
